title: Looking for jobs OUTSIDE LinkedIn? 🔎
description:
Most recruiters utilize multiple platforms when looking for candidates and it's not always the one you think of. Outside of LinkedIn, recruiters use sites like Reddit, Discord channels, TikTok, even YouTube to look for candidates. If recruiters are on these platforms YOU SHOULD BE AS WELL.

Having a strong virtual presence allows you to be searchable for recruiters. Remember, they're always looking for the most qualified candidate and any way you can showcase your skills better, the more you'll stand out. #jobsearch #jobsearchtips #jobsearching #recruiters
